posts.label: Quote 1
posts.quote: I am not what happened to me. I am what I choose to become.
posts.fb_caption: Read it again, slowly. 💜 Your past does not define your future — your choices do. Save this one for the next time someone (or your own inner critic) tries to tell you differently. Who would you share this with?

posts.label: Quote 2
posts.quote: In the depths of winter, I finally discovered that within me there lay an invincible summer.
posts.fb_caption: August is the perfect month to remember this. 🌿 No matter what this season has looked like, there's something unbreakable inside you. 💜 Save this as a reminder that your light doesn't go out — it just gets stronger. What keeps YOUR inner fire burning?
